reviews.title: Perfect for PS5
reviews.comment: 2TB Using in my PS5. Got tired of having to move PS5 games back and forth on an external HDD that I have.  So I decided to go ahead and buy this for extra storage.  And can say that I do not regret it and wish I would have done it earlier.  I can now have access to all of my PS5 games without having to move them between storages.  The capacity is ok but will probably run out quickly as more and more PS5 games are getting to be 100GB or more.  I have 18 games on it and it uses 1.3TB of storage.  Installation was super easy.  5 minutes and I was good to go.  Works perfectly with the PS5 and all my PS5 games are now playable without having to transfer them.
reviews.author: Justin Ramsey

reviews.title: It's done its job so far.
reviews.comment:
I'll give it 4 stars as it did not come with a SSD screw (m2x4 or m2x3)
I placed it into my asus b660 motherboard. It was fairly plug and play, except the screw provided is way too long and will damage your ssd if you intend on using it inside of a desktop tower. The screw provided causes the ssd to sit uneven when it is intended to rest evenly.
Picture provided is on first day of usage, very minimal wear and tear. I'll update in a year or so, or if starts to fail.
reviews.author: Karla
